acceptanceCriteria: TJAA names the Playwright plan's outcome for a changed helper that no spec reaches, in its own unknown vocabulary or as an explicit bounded exclusion, and says why.
A Playwright test shows that outcome for an unreached helper, and a reached helper still selects its specs.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from V1-0204. AFP-V0-020 now names a changed unit that no test reaches as NO_SELECTABLE_TEST in every plugin. The Playwright plan (TJAA) builds on the shared TypeScript graph and widened to the full relevant suite on any shared-graph unknown. V1-0204 keeps that widening tied to the graph's other unknowns, because a full E2E suite cannot exercise a helper that no spec reaches. So an unreached changed helper still leaves the Playwright plan BOUNDED with nothing selected for it. This ticket decides whether the Playwright plan should report that helper, and how.
